The Foster County Recorder is an elected position with a four year term. The current Foster County Recorder is Lynelle Lyman-Hoppe. She was elected in 2002.
As the Recorder she performs the following duties:
Recording of legal documents according to specifications of North Dakota statutes as set forth in the North Dakota Century Code
Maintaining and preserving an archival copy of those records for public use
Issues marriage licenses
Provides passport applications
Administrating and policy functions of the Recorder’s Office
Do and perform all acts not enumerated in this section which the recorder is required to do by law ( see Chapter 11-18: County Recorder. )
Up until August of 2001 the Recorder was known as the Register of Deeds.
